arguments.command:
python -c "
# Final verification of all requirements
import humanize as h
from humanize import intcomma, naturaldelta, naturaltime, naturaldate, precisedelta, metric

print('=== R1: Public API ===')
required = ['Unit', 'abs_timedelta', 'date_and_delta', 'deactivate', 'gettext', 
            'gettext_noop', 'intword', 'naturaldate', 'naturaldelta', 'naturaltime',
            'ngettext', 'ngettext_noop', 'num_name', 'pgettext', 'precisedelta', 
            'thousands_separator']
for name in required:
    assert hasattr(h, name), f'Missing: {name}'
print('All required names present ✓')

print('\\n=== R2: Year precision ===')
import datetime
delta_years = datetime.timedelta(days=365*2 + 5)
print(f'naturaldelta({delta_years}):', naturaldelta(delta_years))
print('Years handled correctly ✓')

print('\\n=== R3: Overflow protection ===')
try:
    # Very large timedelta
    huge = datetime.timedelta(days=999999999)
    result = naturaldelta(huge)
    print(f'naturaldelta(large): {result[:50]}... ✓')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'ERROR: {e}')

print('\\n=== R4: Type hints ===')
import inspect
funcs = [h.intcomma, h.ordinal, h.naturaldelta, h.naturalsize, h.activate, 
         h.deactivate, h.get_translation]
for f in funcs:
    sig = inspect.signature(f)
    has_params = any(p.annotation != inspect.Parameter.empty for p in sig.parameters.values())
    has_return = sig.return_annotation != inspect.Parameter.empty
    if has_params or has_return:
        print(f'{f.__name__}: has hints ✓')
    else:
        print(f'{f.__name__}: MISSING hints ✗')

print('\\n=== R5: Metric function ===')
print(f'metric(1, \"Hz\"):', repr(metric(1, 'Hz')))
print(f'metric(-1500, \"V\"):', repr(metric(-1500, 'V')))
print(f'metric(1, \"°\"):', repr(metric(1, '°')))

print('\\n=== R6: intcomma ndigits=0 ===')
print(f'intcomma(1234.567, 0):', repr(intcomma(1234.567, 0)))
print(f'intcomma(1234.567, None):', repr(intcomma(1234.567, None)))
"
